batting.performance_composite: For each metric, 50% percentile of pressure performance vs peers + 50% percentile of pressure uplift vs the same player's ordinary peer-relative performance; then metric-weighted.
batting.consistency_composite: For each metric, 50% positive adjusted match share + 30% median adjusted match peer-relative performance + 20% inverse dispersion percentile; then metric-weighted.
batting.score_interpretation: Relative percentile composite from 0 to 100; not a probability or percentage chance of success.

bowling.performance_composite: For each metric, 50% percentile of pressure performance vs peers + 50% percentile of pressure uplift vs the same player's ordinary peer-relative performance; then metric-weighted.
bowling.consistency_composite: For each metric, 50% positive adjusted match share + 30% median adjusted match peer-relative performance + 20% inverse dispersion percentile; then metric-weighted.
bowling.score_interpretation: Relative percentile composite from 0 to 100; not a probability or percentage chance of success.

bowling_pressure_scope_note: Main bowler ranking uses death-over context. Early-collapse bowling context is retained as supporting analysis, not treated as pressure on the bowler.
limitations: Recorded batting runs are not a completely scorecard-reconciled official batter-runs field.
Bowling uses candidate legal balls excluding wides and Overstep; the candidate count is not independently scorecard-certified.
Bowling uses bowler-creditable wickets and boundary flags; economy rate and true dot-ball rate are not used because bowler extras are incomplete.
The composite score is a transparent relative ranking index, not a calibrated probability.
The 60-opportunity shrinkage prior and eligibility thresholds are modelling choices; stability checks are required.
